selection_objective: Minimum natural-sample selection log loss; Brier loss breaks ties. Not proof of useful bankruptcy recall.
company_roles: SHA256(seed:CIK) modulo 4: 0 additional training, 1 natural calibration, 2 model/threshold selection, 3 untouched final comparison
limits: Historical nonfinancial annual issuers; no all-market representativeness claim. Prior exposed companies excluded. No resampling to obtain favorable labels. No AWS deployment or automatic model promotion.
